experience.title: THE LEGACY STRIKES BACK
paragraphs: Five years ago an intern joined a bank reconciliation company in Fortaleza. The systems were vast, the legacy ran deep, and the monolith had stood unchallenged for years.
He took it apart. What was once a single Angular system became an independent microservice with its own API, and its frontend was rebuilt in React while the business kept running.
Today he leads the client onboarding portal he has grown with since its first commit — making architecture decisions, running technical discovery, and shipping to production.
